name: sparse_prefill_mxfp8_n_heads128
description: Sparse attention over two CSR ranges. NoPE uses block-scaled E4M3FN and RoPE BF16; each head's sink contributes only to the softmax denominator.

prefix_nope.description: Packed NoPE rows: 448 FP8 codes, 14 E8M0 scales, padding to 512 bytes.

prefix_rope.description: RoPE keys and values corresponding to the NoPE rows.

prefix_indices.description: CSR entries selecting rows of the pool.

prefix_indptr.description: Monotone CSR offsets for each query, beginning with zero.

extend_nope.description: Packed NoPE rows: 448 FP8 codes, 14 E8M0 scales, padding to 512 bytes.

extend_rope.description: RoPE keys and values corresponding to the NoPE rows.

extend_indices.description: CSR entries selecting rows of the pool.

extend_indptr.description: Monotone CSR offsets for each query, beginning with zero.

softmax_scale.description: Multiplier of the combined QK score.

output.description: Weighted sum of 448 dequantized NoPE and 64 RoPE values.
